why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the credit balance, with when, what for and amount. Refunds read "Refund: <action>" in English and "환불: <action>" in Korean. Charges show in red and credits in green with a "+". All new text is in both en.json and ko.json with matching keys. `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean and the page adds no new lint problems. I haven't seen the page in a browser. The table has loading, empty and error states. It loads from the new history endpoint and reloads when the balance changes. Unknown actions fall back to the raw action name.

+import uuid
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def _ws(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def _url(ws):
+    return f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history"
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = _ws(client, h)
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "T", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)  # succeeds: -15
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)  # -15 then +15
+    r = client.get(_url(ws), headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("refund:generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+    ]
+    assert all("created_at" in i for i in items)
+    stamps = [i["created_at"] for i in items]
+    assert stamps == sorted(stamps, reverse=True)
+
+
+def test_history_includes_daily_refill(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = _ws(client, h)
+    client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}", headers=h)  # triggers daily refill
+    items = client.get(_url(ws), headers=h).json()
+    assert ("daily_refill", 50) in [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items]
+
+
+def test_history_is_404_for_non_members_and_unknown_workspaces(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    ws = _ws(client, h)
+    assert client.get(_url(ws), headers=other).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(_url(uuid.uuid4()), headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(_url(ws)).status_code == 401

@@ -0,0 +1,145 @@
+"""Users must not pay for AI work that failed."""
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def _credits(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def _project(client, h):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/characters", headers=h, json={"name": "Mina", "project_id": project_id})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _fail_ai():
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+
+def test_cover_failure_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    _fail_ai()
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_cover_success_still_charges(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before - 15
+
+
+def test_character_sheet_failure_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    cid = _character(client, h, pid)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    _fail_ai()
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_character_sheet_success_still_charges(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    cid = _character(client, h, pid)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before - 20
+
+
+def test_workflow_character_sheet_failure_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    cid = _character(client, h, pid)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    _fail_ai()
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": cid, "name": "Mina", "description": "tall", "style": "ink"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_workflow_art_style_cover_failure_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    _fail_ai()
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/art-style", headers=h, json={"art_style": "ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_text_actions_refund_on_failure(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    _fail_ai()
+    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+    from app.main import app
+
+    # Some endpoints let the AI error escape as a 500; keep it an HTTP response.
+    client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
+    calls = [
+        ("/api/v1/characters/augment", {"project_id": pid, "name": "Mina", "tags": [], "mood": "calm"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggest", {"project_id": pid, "type": "name"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/analyze", {"project_id": pid, "name": "Mina"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggestions/batch", {"project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/projects/worldview/augment", {"description": "x", "title": "t", "genres": []}),
+        ("/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend", {"description": "soft watercolor"}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/ideas", None),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/structure", {"script": "a cat", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/render", {"prompt": "a cat", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/modify", {"original_image_url": "http://x/y.png", "instruction": "x", "project_id": pid}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/create", {"project_id": pid, "title": "Ep", "summary": "s"}),
+    ]
+    for url, body in calls:
+        r = client.post(url, headers=h, json=body) if body is not None else client.post(url, headers=h)
+        assert r.status_code >= 400 or "options" in r.text, (url, r.status_code, r.text)
+        assert _credits(client, h) == before, url
+
+
+def test_style_preview_failure_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    _fail_ai()
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "black ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_refund_is_recorded_as_a_transaction(client):
+    from sqlmodel import Session, select
+

+
